subject: Data Engineering
title: Apache Flink and Friends
description: A short lesson to help you apply Apache Flink and Friends.

hook.text: Alibaba processes billions of events per day with Flink. It handles Singles' Day traffic without breaking a sweat.

buildup.text: Apache Flink is a distributed stream processor known for low latency, exactly-once semantics, and stateful logic.

discovery.text: Spark Structured Streaming uses micro-batches. Kafka Streams runs inside your app. Each has trade-offs.

twist.text: Flink is powerful but complex. Kafka Streams is simpler but limited. Spark bridges batch and stream.

climax.text: The best framework depends on latency needs, team expertise, and existing infrastructure.

punchline.text: Pick the tool that matches your team, not just your traffic.

quiz.question: What is Apache Flink known for in stream processing?
options: Low latency, exactly-once semantics, and stateful processing
